description: This script is designed to test the behavior of git-p4 in handling symlinked directories within a repository, including setup, creation of symlinks, and verification steps.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to Perforce for version control.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to Perforce with a description.

methods.name: p4 sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the workspace with the depot.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.
